1: // Simple Endless Runner – Pixel Dash
2: // Canvas element with id="game" must exist in the HTML.
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   if (!canvas) return console.error('Canvas with id "game" not found');
7:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
8:   const W = canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 800;
9:   const H = canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 400;
10: 
11:   // Player configuration
12:   const player = {
13:     w: 30,
14:     h: 30,
15:     x: 50,
16:     y: H - 60, // start on ground (groundY = H - 30)
17:     vy: 0,
18:     onGround: true,
19:   };
20: 
21:   // Physics
22:   const GRAVITY = 0.6;
23:   const JUMP_VEL = -12;
24:   const GROUND_Y = H - 30; // ground y position for player bottom
25: 
26:   // Obstacles – simple rectangles on ground
27:   let obstacles = [];
28:   let obstacleTimer = 0; // frames until next obstacle
29:   const OBSTACLE_SPACING = 120; // min frames between obstacles
30:   const OBSTACLE_SPEED_START = 4;
31:   let obstacleSpeed = OBSTACLE_SPEED_START;
32: 
33:   // Game state
34:   let running = true;
35:   let frame = 0;
36:   let score = 0;
37: 
38:   // Input – any key or touch triggers a jump if allowed
39:   const tryJump = () => {
40:     if (player.onGround) {
41:       player.vy = JUMP_VEL;
42:       player.onGround = false;
43:     }
44:   };
45:   window.addEventListener('keydown', tryJump);
46:   window.addEventListener('touchstart', e => { e.preventDefault(); tryJump(); }, { passive: false });
47: 
48:   const rectCollision = (a, b) => (
49:     a.x < b.x + b.w && a.x + a.w > b.x &&
50:     a.y < b.y + b.h && a.y + a.h > b.h + b.y
51:   );
52: 
53:   const update = () => {
54:     // Player physics
55:     player.vy += GRAVITY;
56:     player.y += player.vy;
57:     if (player.y + player.h >= GROUND_Y) {
58:       player.y = GROUND_Y - player.h;
59:       player.vy = 0;
60:       player.onGround = true;
61:     }
62: 
63:     // Obstacle management
64:     obstacleTimer--;
65:     if (obstacleTimer <= 0) {
66:       // create new obstacle with random height (20‑80px)
67:       const height = 20 + Math.random() * 60;
68:       obstacles.push({ x: W, y: GROUND_Y - height, w: 20, h: height });
69:       obstacleTimer = OBSTACLE_SPACING + Math.random() * 60;
70:     }
71:     // move obstacles left
72:     for (let i = obstacles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
73:       const o = obstacles[i];
74:       o.x -= obstacleSpeed;
75:       // remove off‑screen
76:       if (o.x + o.w < 0) {
77:         obstacles.splice(i, 1);
78:         score++;
79:       } else if (rectCollision(player, o)) {
80:         running = false;
81:       }
82:     }
83: 
84:     // increase speed gradually
85:     obstacleSpeed += 0.001;
86:   };
87: 
88:   const draw = () => {
89:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
90:     // ground line
91:     ctx.fillStyle = '#555';
92:     ctx.fillRect(0, GROUND_Y, W, 2);
93: 
94:     // player
95:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0f0';
96:     ctx.fillRect(player.x, player.y, player.w, player.h);
97: 
98:     // obstacles
99:     ctx.fillStyle = '#f00';
100:     for (const o of obstacles) {
101:       ctx.fillRect(o.x, o.y, o.w, o.h);
102:     }
103: 
104:     // score
105:     ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
106:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
107:     ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, 10, 20);
108: 
109:     if (!running) {
110:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
111:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
112:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
113:       ctx.font = '32px sans-serif';
114:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
115:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', W / 2, H / 2);
116:     }
117:   };
118: 
119:   const loop = () => {
120:     if (!running) {
121:       draw();
122:       return; // stop animation
123:     }
124:     frame++;
125:     update();
126:     draw();
127:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
128:   };
129: 
130:   // Start the game
131:   loop();
132: })();
